build_pq_fastscan_index: build a FAISS IndexPQFastScan index with 64 dimensions, 8 sub-vectors, and 4-bit encoding
create_index_refine_flat: create an IndexRefineFlat wrapper around a PQFastScan index for refined nearest-neighbor search
train_refined_index: train the IndexRefineFlat index on a database of random float32 vectors
search_with_refinement: search the refined index using IndexRefineSearchParameters with a configurable k_factor
search_pq_fastscan_index: search the base IndexPQFastScan index with a configurable nprobe value
